answer.justification: All logit-level measurements are exactly zero or one. Top-1 and sequence agreement are 1.000, KL, TV and Token-DiFR gap are 0.000, and the raw-score shift ÷ TV is undefined (0 ÷ 0). This is the signature of 'none'. Quantization, the closest class, would show KL around 0.05, TV around 0.05 and top-1 agreement around 0.95. Every other class shows larger logit changes still. Output and activation levels were not measured, so I cannot confirm the model is identical at those levels.
